name: cleora_orb_open_dramatic -> eyes_dilated_purple
shot_a_desc: A claymation fortune teller gazes into a crystal ball that suddenly flares with intense purple light, illuminating her face.
shot_b_desc: The camera slowly pushes in on an extreme close-up of a wide-eyed, startled claymation face surrounded by purple smoke.
gemini_notes: The cut to the extreme close-up is abrupt, but the continuous purple lighting and smoke effectively bridge the two shots to imply we are seeing a vision emerging from the crystal ball.

name: Portal to sick man
shot_a_desc: A claymation fortune teller gazes into a glowing purple crystal ball as the camera rapidly zooms in and the lighting intensifies.
shot_b_desc: A claymation woman in historical clothing touches the forehead of a sweating, crying man lying in bed as the camera slowly pulls back.
gemini_notes: The rapid zoom and lighting change in the first shot effectively sell the cut as diving into a crystal ball vision, making the transition to a completely different historical setting feel intentional rather than disconnected.
owner_note: Any footage that showcases a sick man

name: wide shot/glowing orb
shot_a_desc: A wide shot slowly pushes in on a claymation fortune teller sitting in a detailed, root-ceilinged apothecary, her hands hovering over a glowing crystal ball.
shot_b_desc: A close-up on the fortune teller shows the crystal ball suddenly flaring with intense purple light, illuminating her shocked expression as the background fades to black.
cut_reads_as: scale change on the same subject
gemini_notes: The shots clearly read as the same location, but the dramatic shift to heavy purple lighting in the close-up establishes a sudden, intense tone.

name: Reading book, and surprised
shot_a_desc: A claymation fortune-teller sits at a candlelit table reading a mystical book, and the camera slowly pushes in as she looks up.
shot_b_desc: The camera cuts to an extreme close-up of the fortune-teller's face with wide, shocked eyes, then slowly pulls back.
cut_reads_as: sudden revelation and reaction to what was just read
gemini_notes: The cut is an intentionally jarring jump to an extreme close-up that reads perfectly as a sudden, horrifying realization about whatever she was just reading.

name: Reading book, and surprised

shot_b_desc: An extreme close-up on the fortune-teller's wide, staring eyes pulls back to reveal her shocked expression.
cut_reads_as: reaction to what was just seen and a dramatic scale change on the same subject

name: brewing surprised

shot_b_desc: An extreme close-up of the fortune-teller's face shows her eyes suddenly snapping wide open in shock as the camera slightly pulls back.
cut_reads_as: a sudden, shocking realization or terrifying vision
gemini_notes: The abrupt jump from a wide shot to an extreme close-up creates an intentionally jarring shock effect, accompanied by a noticeable shift to dramatic purple lighting.
